text.description_html:
Acorn RMRBP, Rough Black Iron 30 x 5-7/8 Kick Plates

These hearty iron door kick plates give an old world charm to any home door or garden gate. Finished with a vinyl lacquer for many years of anti-rust protection. The 30 x 5-7/8 Rough Black Iron Door Kick Plate comes packaged with mounting screws for easy installation. The rough iron surface duplicates that found on the ironwork of many old European castles and cathedrals and imitates the natural weathering of iron.

When combined with our other great Hand Forged Iron Products, Acorn can really make your home stand out.

Features for the Acorn Iron Door Kick Plates:

  • Finish: Rough Black Iron
  • Width: 30"
  • Height: 5-7/8
  • Vinyl lacquer sealed.
  • Packaged with mounting screws.
  • Lifetime No-Rust Warranty

Kick Plates are typically the width of the door less 2 inches. If your door is 36" wide you would install a 34" wide kick plate to allow approximately 1" of border at each side.
Please measure each door for proper fit.

Sold individually. Package includes 1 kick plate and hardware for a surface mounted application.
